snow_disclosure_recheck.limitations: Rendered disclosure only; not merchant validation or competitive lead. No runtime change in this research.

limitations: Counts are merchant listings, not unique models or distinct inventory.
Retained-feed comparison isolates thirteen recovered in-stock listings, eleven at least 40% off; final refresh may include independent stock/price changes.
Fixed top-ten/seeded-twenty sample plus targeted new listings is not proof of 99% population accuracy or competitive superiority.
Retailer references are not verified historical street prices. Mike’s Bikes advertises $79 assembly added at checkout; closeouts are final and manufacturer shipping restrictions apply.

Initial full refresh was deliberately stopped before any completed source to apply a review-found singular Battery exclusion. Final candidate uses the reviewed code throughout. Isolated source audit preceded that negative guard; complete raw replay confirms unchanged accepted records, and final combined audit covers recovered offers again.
Prior-day history remains exact; current-day rows use existing latest-successful-daily policy.
Competitor evidence keeps its original dates; no all-metric lead claim.
